title: Member Share of an Eyeglasses Order — Vision Plans Claims Adjudication Rules
content:
**Applies to:** eyeglasses orders on the Vision Plans.

**A. The order.** An eyeglasses order is the spectacle-lens line, the frame line or both of one claim of the enrollment. A routine exam line of the claim belongs to the exam visit; contact lenses and their fitting belong to the contact-lens order.

The order decided is the claim found first in this sequence:
1. the latest received spectacle-lens line with no remark yet at a participating independent practice;
2. the same at a participating retail-chain location;
3. the latest received frame line with no remark yet at a participating independent practice;
4. the same at a participating retail-chain location;
5. the latest received spectacle-lens line standing denied as not eligible, at any location;
6. the latest received frame line standing denied as not eligible, at any location.

An out-of-network order already filed by the member and denied for eligibility is reprocessed the same way. The order's date of service, received date, network channel and provider agreement are those of its lines. Each line's charge is its retail charge. The lens type and lens options are read from the lens line. The patient's age is counted in whole years from the enrollee's date of birth to the date of service.

**B. Coverage.** The order is settled under the materials benefit only when the enrollment is active or terminated, and the date of service is on or after the coverage effective date and on or before the termination date when there is one. Otherwise its lines are denied as not eligible and the member pays the whole retail charge.

**C. No benefit.** A lens line on a plan with no spectacle-lens benefit, or a frame line on a plan with no frame benefit, is denied as not covered. At a participating location it is bought at the plan's materials discount percent off its retail charge; out of network nothing is reimbursed.

**D. Frequency.** Each line is settled under its benefit only when that benefit is available again: the lens frequency (the child lens frequency for a patient under 19) for the lenses, and the frame frequency for the frame. The benefit of a kind is available again unless the latest service of that kind of the enrollment whose remark is paid or out-of-network reimbursement paid blocks it:
- *Benefit-year basis:* a 12-month frequency is blocked by a latest service in the same benefit period, and a 24-month frequency by one in the same or the preceding benefit period. A latest service in a later period blocks nothing.
- *From-last-service basis:* the benefit is blocked when fewer than the stated number of whole calendar months separate the two dates, in either direction; a month is complete on the same day number.
- *Reversals:* when that latest service is the only paid or reimbursed one of its kind on its date and has been reversed, nothing blocks. Where there are several on that date, reversing one leaves the benefit blocked.

A blocked line is denied for frequency. It is bought at the materials discount percent off its retail charge at a participating location and is not reimbursed out of network.

**E. Contacts-in-lieu.** A contact-lens service of the same person counts in the order's benefit period when it is the latest contact-lens service of the enrollment whose remark is paid or out-of-network reimbursement paid, and its date of service falls in the same benefit period as the order, whatever its order against it. Spectacle lenses, frames and contact lenses are each a kind of their own. When that latest contact-lens service is the only one on its date and has been reversed, there is taken to be none and no earlier one is looked at; of several on that date, a reversal of one leaves the date standing. A benefit period is the twelve-month period starting each year on the enrollment's benefit-period reset day, and a latest service in another period counts nothing. When such a service counts, the order's lens and frame lines are denied as contacts in lieu of glasses. They are bought at the materials discount percent off their retail charges at a participating location and are not reimbursed out of network.

**F. Materials benefit, participating location.**
- *Lens line:* the member pays the materials copay, plus the plan's single-vision lens copay, plus polycarbonate, plus the plan copay of each ordered UV coating or scratch-resistant coating. Polycarbonate costs nothing for a patient under 19 on a plan that covers children's polycarbonate, and the adult polycarbonate copay otherwise.
- *Frame line:* the frame receives the plan's independent-practice frame allowance at an independent practice, or its retail-chain allowance at a retail-chain location. The member pays the part of the retail charge above the allowance, less the plan's overage discount percent of that part at an independent practice only. The member also pays the materials copay when the order carries no lens line.

**G. Out of network.** The member pays each receipt less the lesser of the receipt and its out-of-network amount, with no copay and no option reimbursed. The lens amount follows the lens type, progressive lenses of either kind using the progressive amount; the frame uses the out-of-network frame amount.

**H. The member share.** It is defined in this order:
1. The lens line's materials copay, lens-type copay and every option copay that applies are added into one copay total, and every lens credit that applies is taken off it, never below 0.00.
2. The frame line's share is added.

A line denied for frequency, contacts-in-lieu or lack of a benefit counts at its discounted retail charge instead. The share is booked on the order's first line and rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** Participating independent practice; a patient aged 40; a plan with a 25.00 materials copay, single-vision copay 0.00, scratch coating 17.00, frame allowance 130.00 and overage discount 20%. Single-vision lenses with scratch coating; frame retail 166.35.
- Lens copay total: 25.00 plus 0.00 plus 17.00, which is 42.00.
- Frame share: 36.35 above the allowance, less 7.27, which is 29.08.
- Member share: 71.08.
